About Us

Bothbest is a China-based manufacturer dedicated exclusively to rapidly renewable bamboo. We produce a comprehensive range of bamboo flooring, outdoor bamboo decking, bamboo panels, and architectural bamboo products.

Equipped with automated precision machinery, Bothbest is recognized as a reliable supplier and exporter across global bamboo markets. With more than 20 years of manufacturing experience and strict quality control, our products are trusted by importers, contractors, and end-users worldwide.

Our main facilities are located in China's core Moso bamboo region, where abundant bamboo forests are harvested sustainably on a rotating cycle. By combining selected Moso bamboo culms, low-VOC adhesives, and precision profiling, Bothbest supplies stable, wear-resistant products exported across Europe (Germany, France, Italy, UK, and more), the USA, and Australia.

Bothbest operates under ISO 9001 quality management and ISO 14001 environmental management standards.

Eco Mission

Our mission is to manufacture durable, non-toxic, and ecologically sustainable bamboo building materials that deliver factory-direct value and dependable service to distributors, architects, builders, and homeowners.

By focusing exclusively on Moso bamboo utilization—maximizing bamboo yield while reducing hardwood logging—we actively support forest conservation and sustainable building practices.

Global Sales

Since 2001, Bothbest has exported environmentally friendly bamboo building products to over 40 countries worldwide (highlighted in red below).

Europe: Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, Netherlands, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, UK, Russia, Slovakia, Poland, Austria, Kosovo, Turkey

North America: USA, Canada, Mexico

Asia: South Korea, Japan, India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Singapore, Philippines, Brunei, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, UAE

South America: Panama, Colombia, Brazil, Chile, Argentina

Oceania: Australia, New Zealand

Africa: South Africa, Nigeria, Morocco
